name: Experimental and numerical data from comparative analysis of candidate structural models for active camber morphing wings
description:
This data article presents modal test data of 10 uniform cantilever plates and 20 varying-thickness stepped cantilever plates fabricated using PLA through 3D printing and aluminium alloy through CNC machining. In addition, it provides finite element modal (FEM) numerical data obtained from structural models based on different structural theories, with material parameters identified from standard material tests. To analyse the material anisotropy of 3D-printed specimens, 21 tensile specimens were fabricated with 7 different print orientations and tested in repeated material experiments. The dataset contains raw modal test data and non-contact scanning parameters from all experiments, 3D printing tolerance verification and tolerance measurements of all specimens, anisotropy measurements of 3D-printed materials, detailed information and FEM model files of numerical analyses, as well as raw data from uniaxial tensile tests and non-contact modal testing. The related research article “Comparative analysis of beam-plate coupled models for active camber morphing wings” provides a detailed description of the experimental program.
>>> FIle Description
* 1-1 Modal Test Experiment and Numerical Results.xlsx: Contains the modal frequencies of all specimens from experiments and the dimensionless frequencies. It also includes the results from all numerical models and the corresponding dimensionless frequency errors compared with experimental data.
* 1-2 Original data of modal tests.xlsx: Raw frequency spectra obtained from PSV-400 modal experiments, where the peaks correspond to different mode shapes.
* 2-1 Tolerance inspection of FDM 3D printer.xlsx: Manufacturing tolerances of the FDM 3D printer used in this study, obtained from 25 XYZ calibration cubes.
* 2-2 Specimen tolerance.xlsx: Actual dimensions of all experimental specimens, which can be used to correct for tolerances during the dimensionless processing in 1-1.
* 3-1 Material property.xlsx: Measured elastic modulus and failure stress of 3D-printed PLA specimens with seven different print orientations, including mean values and standard deviations.
* 3-2 Originial date of material tests.xlsx: Raw uniaxial tensile test data of 21 3D-printed PLA specimens.
* 4-1 FEM Detail.xlsx: Details of all finite element models, including element types, number of elements, degrees of freedom, computational time, and numerical errors.
* ABAQUS inp Files: Numerical models of uniform cantilever beams.
* Nastran bdf Files: Numerical models of stepped cantilever plates.
* FDM Stp Files: 3D CAD models of all specimens used in this study.
* Modal Animation Video Files: Modal shape animations for all types of test specimens.
